name: Zeta logarithmic derivative coefficient identity

name: Generalized logarithmic-derivative coefficients

ant_standard_definition.formula: If D_f(s)=prod_p F_p(p^{-s}), define -D_f'(s)/D_f(s)=sum_{n>=1} Lambda_f(n)n^{-s} where justified

local_rule: If -x F_p'(x)/F_p(x)=sum_{k>=1} b_f(p^k)x^k, then Lambda_f(p^k)=b_f(p^k) log p and Lambda_f(n)=0 off prime powers

counterexamples.claim: Every arithmetic function has such coefficients with prime-power support
counterexamples.counterexample: The prime-power support conclusion depends on an Euler-product factorization
